Mirror your iPhone screen to the headunit over WiFi. Still in beta and not usable yet: waiting for the KlikBeam iPhone app to be released.\n\nHow to connect: join the headunit to your iPhone\'s hotspot, tap OPEN RECEIVER, then in KlikBeam pick this headunit and enter pairing code %1$s. If the headunit does not show up, type the address: %2$s.
